title: RealtimeEnvelope v1
description:
Control-plane WebSocket message envelope. Carries authorization and state-change notifications ONLY.

This channel MUST NOT carry clipboard payloads. Its purpose is the inverse: it tells an agent that its cached authorization is stale, so the agent re-fetches a roster and continues to move clipboard data device-to-device. Every message is bounded, typed and versioned. See ADR-006.

v.description: Envelope version, independent of the clipboard protocol version.

id.description: Correlation id. Echoed by the peer in a response or ack.

data.description: Type-specific body. Validated per message type by the receiver.

clientToServer.description:
ping: liveness. device.heartbeat: coalesced last-seen update. roster.request: ask for a fresh roster out of band. ack: acknowledge a correlated server message.

Note what is absent: there is no client-to-server message that carries clipboard content, by design.

serverToClient.description: connection.ready: authenticated, carries negotiated versions. authorization.changed / roster.invalidated: cached authorization is stale, re-fetch. device.revoked: this device is revoked and MUST stop syncing and disconnect. session.*: membership or lifetime changed. error: bounded, non-leaking error.

rosterVersion.description: The version the client should now be able to fetch. Lets a client detect that it is behind without polling.

message.description: Human-readable, non-sensitive. MUST NOT contain tokens, keys, stack traces or clipboard data.
